name: Valor's Rest
summary: At Silithus's eastern edge, Valor's Rest gives travelers shelter beside its cemetery.

sections.title: Gateway to the Dunes
sections.body: At Silithus's eastern border, Valor's Rest stands beside the ramp down from Un'Goro Crater. The Cenarion Circle keeps the camp neutral. Alliance and Horde travelers gather there before crossing into the arid wastes. Its graveyard marks those lost to the desert, where insectoid horrors and ancient threats endanger even the hardiest travelers.

faq.answer: Valor's Rest lies at Silithus's eastern entrance, along the path from Un'Goro Crater's northwestern corner into the desert.
The Cenarion Circle keeps Valor's Rest neutral for Alliance and Horde travelers.

faq.q: What is the notable feature of this camp?
faq.answer: Valor's Rest is known for its graveyard, where those claimed by the desert and its insectoid inhabitants are buried.

faq.q: Is Valor's Rest safe from the surrounding wildlife?
faq.answer: Insect infestations reach the area around Valor's Rest, warning of the swarm deeper in Silithus.

angles.text: As a druid, you see the Cenarion Circle keeping watch at Valor's Rest as troubling stirrings trouble the southern desert.
As an Alliance traveler, you find a small refuge at Valor's Rest after emerging from Un'Goro's wilds. The Horde shares it under Cenarion neutrality.
